mentions.name: Volt-Test Laravel performance testing package
mentions.description: This is a Laravel package that integrates the Volt-Test performance testing engine directly into the Laravel framework, with automatic route discovery and support for writing performance scenarios using familiar testing patterns.
mentions.source_excerpt:
For Laravel developers, I also released a package that integrates Volt-Test directly into the framework:

https://github.com/volt-test/laravel-performance-testing

It supports automatic route discovery and makes it easy to write performance scenarios using familiar testing patterns.
